tasks.label: run-client
tasks.command: { lsof -ti :5268; lsof -ti :5000; } 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; sleep 0.3; dotnet build ${workspaceFolder}/RugbyEngine.slnx && (dotnet run --no-build --project ${workspaceFolder}/RugbyEngine.Client/RugbyEngine.Client.csproj > /tmp/rugbyengine-client.log 2>&1 &) && until lsof -ti :5268 > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.5; done && echo 'Client ready on port 5268'
